## AuditLogFilterInput

Filter for \`adminAuditLog\` / \`adminAuditLogCount\` queries. All fields are optional; absent fields match any value.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actorKind` | `String` |  | Restrict to actor origin kind: \`"user"\`, \`"system"\` or \`"api\_key"\`. |
| `actorUserId` | `ID` |  | Restrict to events performed by or delegated from a specific user. |
| `category` | `String` |  | Restrict to a specific category: \`"config"\`, \`"organization"\`, \`"user"\`, \`"workspace"\`, \`"feature"\`, \`"template"\`, \`"logging"\`, \`"cache"\`. |
| `credentialId` | `String` |  | Restrict to delegated credential id. |
| `credentialType` | `String` |  | Restrict to delegated credential type, e.g. \`"mcp\_api\_key"\`. |
| `eventKeyPrefix` | `String` |  | Restrict to events whose \`eventKey\` starts with this prefix. |
| `from` | [DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime) |  | Lower bound (inclusive) on \`createdAt\`. |
| `targetId` | `String` |  | Restrict to events affecting a specific entity ID (requires \`targetType\`). |
| `targetType` | `String` |  | Restrict to events affecting a specific entity type. |
| `targetUnitId` | `ID` |  | Restrict to events tagged with a specific Organisationseinheit (\`target\_unit\_id\`). Set automatically by \`myOrganizationAuditLog\`. |
| `to` | [DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime) |  | Upper bound (inclusive) on \`createdAt\`. |

## DatabaseCsvExportOptionsInput

Quote strategy applied to CSV export. \`MINIMAL\` (default) only quotes fields that contain the delimiter, the quote byte, a newline, or leading/trailing whitespace. \`ALL\` quotes every field so the consumer can rely on positional round-trips regardless of cell content.

## GitSyncProfileInput

Input for creating or updating a Git Sync profile. Contains the repository URL, branch, authentication credentials, and synchronisation configuration. The \`token\`, \`username\`, \`sshPrivateKey\`, and \`sshPassphrase\` fields carry secrets and are never persisted in plaintext — they are encrypted before storage.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authMethod` | [GitSyncAuthMethod](./enums.md#gitsyncauthmethod)! |  | Authentication method for the remote. |
| `branch` | `String` |  | Branch to synchronise with (default: \`main\`). |
| `credentialExpiresAt` | [DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime) |  | Optional expiry timestamp for the credential (ISO 8601). If set, the sync engine will refuse to use expired credentials. |
| `cronExpression` | `String` |  |  |
| `cronMisfirePolicy` | [GitSyncCronMisfirePolicy](./enums.md#gitsynccronmisfirepolicy) |  |  |
| `cronTimezone` | `String` |  |  |
| `maxMirrorStorageMb` | `Int` |  | Per-workspace mirror storage limit in MB. If null, the global \`max\_mirror\_storage\_mb\` from server config is used. |
| `password` | `String` |  | Password (for \`HttpsPassword\` auth). |
| `pollingIntervalSecs` | `Int` |  | Seconds between automatic sync runs (only used with \`Polling\` trigger mode). |
| `repoUrl` | `String`! |  | HTTPS or SSH URL of the remote Git repository. |
| `rootPath` | `String` |  | Subdirectory inside the repo for managed content (default: \`content/\`). |
| `sshPassphrase` | `String` |  | Passphrase for the SSH private key (optional). |
| `sshPrivateKey` | `String` |  | PEM-encoded SSH private key (for \`SshKey\` auth). |
| `syncDirection` | [GitSyncDirection](./enums.md#gitsyncdirection) |  | Synchronisation direction (default: \`Bidirectional\`). |
| `token` | `String` |  | Personal access token (for \`HttpsToken\` auth). |
| `triggerMode` | [GitSyncTriggerMode](./enums.md#gitsynctriggermode) |  | How sync runs are triggered (default: \`Manual\`). |
| `username` | `String` |  | Username (for \`HttpsPassword\` or \`HttpsToken\` auth). |

## PdfExportInputV2Input

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `colorVariant` | `String` |  | Color treatment applied to the effective document palette. |
| `complianceProfile` | `String` |  | Optional PDF writer standards profile. Accepted values are \`"standard"\`, \`"pdfa-1b"\`, \`"pdfa-2b"\`, \`"pdfa-2u"\`, \`"pdfa-3b"\` and \`"pdfua-1"\`. PDF/X is intentionally not accepted until the renderer has a proven PDF/X output path. |
| `confidentialityLabel` | `String` |  | Confidentiality watermark label. Must be present in the manifest's \`confidentialityLabels\` allowed-set. |
| `coverPage` | `Boolean` |  | Cover-page override; absence uses the selected template default. |
| `docId` | `String`! |  | Document UUID. Nanoid forms are accepted by the underlying parser but the canonical wire form is the UUIDv5 derived from the nanoid. |
| `documentVersionId` | `String` |  | Document-version selector from the export dialog. \`latest\` means "current document state"; if document versioning is enabled and \`on\_pdf\_export\` is configured, the server captures a named snapshot before rendering. A UUID pins the render to that named version's DocHistory snapshot. |
| `footerStyle` | `String` |  | Footer layout from the selected template capability; absence keeps its default. |
| `imageQuality` | `String` |  | Image quality tier. Accepts \`"low"\` / \`"med"\` / \`"high"\` / \`"lossless"\`. This per-render value overrides \`pdf\_export\_settings\` and is persisted in the render-input/audit snapshot. |
| `locale` | `String` |  | Override locale (BCP-47, e.g. \`"de-AT"\`). Falls through to the brand default and finally to the server default when \`None\`. |
| `orientation` | `String` |  | Page orientation. Always available independent of template capabilities. Defaults to portrait for every export. |
| `pageNumbering` | `String` |  | Page-number format independent of the selected footer layout. |
| `paperSize` | `String` |  | Per-render override for the paper size: \`"A4"\`, \`"Letter"\`, \`"A3"\`, \`"A5"\`, or \`"16:9"\`. The renderer consumes these V2 literals directly. |
| `templateId` | `String`! |  | Template selector — accepts the kebab-case slug (\`"default"\`/\`"report"\`/\`"letter"\`) or a UUID. The slug path is preserved for backward compat with clients that have not migrated to UUIDs; both forms resolve through the V2 registry. |
| `tocBehavior` | `String` |  | TOC behavior — \`"off"\` / \`"auto"\` / \`"force"\`. |
| `typedInputs` | [JSON](./scalars.md#json) |  | Free-form template inputs validated against the manifest's \`inputs\_schema\`. Persisted on \`pdf\_export\_render\_audit.l3\_inputs\` for compliance. |
| `workspaceId` | `String`! |  | Workspace UUID (string-form for GraphQL transport). |

## ResolveConflictInput

Input for resolving a Git Sync conflict. The caller selects one of the available resolution strategies. For \`ManualMerge\`, the \`mergedContent\` field must contain the user-edited Markdown that replaces both conflicting versions.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conflictId` | `String`! |  | ID of the conflict to resolve. |
| `mergedContent` | `String` |  | User-edited Markdown content (required for \`ManualMerge\`). |
| `resolution` | [GitSyncConflictResolution](./enums.md#gitsyncconflictresolution)! |  | Resolution strategy to apply. |

## ResolveFileConflictInput

Input for resolving a non-Markdown Git Sync file conflict. File conflicts are binary/blob decisions. \`ManualMerge\` is therefore not a valid file resolution and is rejected by the server mutation.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conflictId` | `String`! |  | ID of the file conflict to resolve. |
| `resolution` | [GitSyncConflictResolution](./enums.md#gitsyncconflictresolution)! |  | Resolution strategy to apply. |
